text: Deleted memories still show up in search results for about 10 minutes after deletion.
The delete API returns a success response but the record is still retrievable for several minutes afterward.
Export of our memory store keeps hanging at 90% and eventually times out on large datasets.
Search queries that used to return instantly now take several seconds since the update.
We were double-charged this month, both the annual and monthly plan fees hit our card.
The pricing page doesn't explain what counts as a memory unit, had to email sales to understand our bill.
Would love a way to set custom TTLs per memory namespace instead of one global expiry setting.
Please add a bulk-delete API so we don't have to loop single deletes for GDPR erasure requests.
Since the redesign, the usage stats page is buried three menus deep. Please bring back the old nav item.
Navigation got worse after the update, takes forever to find the API key page now.
The quickstart docs reference an SDK method that no longer exists in the current package version.
Docs for the Python SDK are out of date, the retrieve() example throws a deprecation warning not mentioned anywhere.
Our webhook integration stopped firing after the last API version bump, no error shown, events just stop arriving.
The REST API rate limit dropped without any changelog notice, now we get 429s constantly during peak hours.
Got locked out of our workspace after an SSO provider change, support couldn't restore access for 6 hours.
Two of my teammates lost admin access after we rotated our SSO certificate.
Support responded to my critical outage ticket in under 10 minutes and fixed it live on the call. Genuinely impressed.
Support closed my ticket as resolved without actually fixing the underlying issue, had to reopen it twice.
Really solid experience overall, the CLI tools especially make local dev testing painless.
Just a neutral note, usage has been stable this week, no complaints and nothing exciting either.
